en.answer: Even if the only face-up Field Spell Card on the field is in your opponent's Field Zone, you can activate the effect of <<14379>>.
en.question: If I do not have a face-up Field Spell Card in my Field Zone but my opponent has a face-up Field Spell Card in theirs, can I activate the effect of <<14379>>?
